Thanks to a network of partner universities throughout Europe, you will be able to live an international experience, improve your language skills and broaden your cultural and professional horizons. The program Outgoing mobility Erasmus+ Tutor Erasmus+ Projects ECHE Erasmus Experiences Erasmus Buddy Friends International Calls The program Erasmus+, the European Union programme for Education, Training, Youth and Sport, aims to give over four million people, including students, trainees, teachers and volunteers, the opportunity to benefit from grants to study, train, teach or volunteer abroad. Erasmus+ is part of a socio-economic context where, on the one hand, almost 6 million young Europeans are unemployed, with levels exceeding 50% in some countries. At the same time, there are over 2 million job vacancies and a third of employers report difficulties in recruiting staff with the required qualifications. This demonstrates the existence of significant skills gaps in Europe. Erasmus+ is designed to provide concrete answers to these issues, through opportunities for study, training, work experience or volunteering abroad. The quality and relevance of European education, training and youth care organisations and systems will be increased through support for improved teaching and learning methods, new programmes and the professional development of teaching staff and youth workers, and through increased cooperation between the worlds of education and training and the world of work to address real needs in terms of human and social capital development, in Europe and beyond. Outgoing mobility UKE Student Mobility Choose from partner universities for international experiences and enrich your path. UKE Teacher Mobility Expand your career path with international experiences at partner universities. Mobility for staff TA Enrich your journey with unique experiences at international partner universities. Erasmus+ Tutor The Erasmus+ Representatives are your point of reference for all the information and assistance you need during the program. They will accompany you in every phase, from the initial orientation to filling out the paperwork, ensuring you have a simple and obstacle-free mobility experience abroad. Erasmus+ is part of a socio-economic context where, on the one hand, almost 6 million young Europeans are unemployed, with levels exceeding 50% in some countries. Erasmus+ is designed to provide concrete answers to these issues, through opportunities for study, training, work experience or volunteering abroad. The quality and relevance of European education, training and youth care organisations and systems will be increased through support for improved teaching and learning methods, new programmes and the professional development of teaching staff and youth workers, and through increased cooperation between the worlds of education and training and the world of work to address real needs in terms of human and social capital development, in Europe and beyond. Thanks to a network of partner universities throughout Europe, you will be able to live an international experience, improve your language skills and broaden your cultural and professional horizons. The program Outgoing mobility Erasmus+ Tutor Erasmus+ Projects ECHE Erasmus Experiences Erasmus Buddy Friends International Calls The program Erasmus+, the European Union programme for Education, Training, Youth and Sport, aims to give over four million people, including students, trainees, teachers and volunteers, the opportunity to benefit from grants to study, train, teach or volunteer abroad. Erasmus+ is part of a socio-economic context where, on the one hand, almost 6 million young Europeans are unemployed, with levels exceeding 50% in some countries. At the same time, there are over 2 million job vacancies and a third of employers report difficulties in recruiting staff with the required qualifications. This demonstrates the existence of significant skills gaps in Europe. Erasmus+ is designed to provide concrete answers to these issues, through opportunities for study, training, work experience or volunteering abroad. The quality and relevance of European education, training and youth care organisations and systems will be increased through support for improved teaching and learning methods, new programmes and the professional development of teaching staff and youth workers, and through increased cooperation between the worlds of education and training and the world of work to address real needs in terms of human and social capital development, in Europe and beyond. Thanks to a network of partner universities throughout Europe, you will be able to live an international experience, improve your language skills and broaden your cultural and professional horizons. The program Outgoing mobility Erasmus+ Tutor Erasmus+ Projects ECHE Erasmus Experiences Erasmus Buddy Friends International Calls The program Erasmus+, the European Union programme for Education, Training, Youth and Sport, aims to give over four million people, including students, trainees, teachers and volunteers, the opportunity to benefit from grants to study, train, teach or volunteer abroad. Erasmus+ is part of a socio-economic context where, on the one hand, almost 6 million young Europeans are unemployed, with levels exceeding 50% in some countries. At the same time, there are over 2 million job vacancies and a third of employers report difficulties in recruiting staff with the required qualifications. This demonstrates the existence of significant skills gaps in Europe. Erasmus+ is designed to provide concrete answers to these issues, through opportunities for study, training, work experience or volunteering abroad. The quality and relevance of European education, training and youth care organisations and systems will be increased through support for improved teaching and learning methods, new programmes and the professional development of teaching staff and youth workers, and through increased cooperation between the worlds of education and training and the world of work to address real needs in terms of human and social capital development, in Europe and beyond. Outgoing mobility UKE Student Mobility Choose from partner universities for international experiences and enrich your path. UKE Teacher Mobility Expand your career path with international experiences at partner universities. Mobility for staff TA Enrich your journey with unique experiences at international partner universities. Erasmus+ Tutor The Erasmus+ Representatives are your point of reference for all the information and assistance you need during the program. They will accompany you in every phase, from the initial orientation to filling out the paperwork, ensuring you have a simple and obstacle-free mobility experience abroad. Specifically, the Office provides information and administrative support to students selected for International Mobility programs (Erasmus+ Study, Erasmus+ Traineeship), oversees the establishment and renewal of international agreements and conventions for the exchange of faculty, students, and technical-administrative staff, and supports the development of internationalization projects. Additionally, it facilitates the reception of international students and guests. Thanks to a network of partner universities throughout Europe, you will be able to live an international experience, improve your language skills and broaden your cultural and professional horizons. The program Outgoing mobility Erasmus+ Tutor Erasmus+ Projects ECHE Erasmus Experiences Erasmus Buddy Friends International Calls The program Erasmus+, the European Union programme for Education, Training, Youth and Sport, aims to give over four million people, including students, trainees, teachers and volunteers, the opportunity to benefit from grants to study, train, teach or volunteer abroad. Erasmus+ is part of a socio-economic context where, on the one hand, almost 6 million young Europeans are unemployed, with levels exceeding 50% in some countries. At the same time, there are over 2 million job vacancies and a third of employers report difficulties in recruiting staff with the required qualifications. This demonstrates the existence of significant skills gaps in Europe. Erasmus+ is designed to provide concrete answers to these issues, through opportunities for study, training, work experience or volunteering abroad. The quality and relevance of European education, training and youth care organisations and systems will be increased through support for improved teaching and learning methods, new programmes and the professional development of teaching staff and youth workers, and through increased cooperation between the worlds of education and training and the world of work to address real needs in terms of human and social capital development, in Europe and beyond. Outgoing mobility UKE Student Mobility Choose from partner universities for international experiences and enrich your path. UKE Teacher Mobility Expand your career path with international experiences at partner universities. Mobility for staff TA Enrich your journey with unique experiences at international partner universities. Erasmus+ Tutor The Erasmus+ Representatives are your point of reference for all the information and assistance you need during the program. They will accompany you in every phase, from the initial orientation to filling out the paperwork, ensuring you have a simple and obstacle-free mobility experience abroad. Thanks to a network of partner universities throughout Europe, you will be able to live an international experience, improve your language skills and broaden your cultural and professional horizons. The program Outgoing mobility Erasmus+ Tutor Erasmus+ Projects ECHE Erasmus Experiences Erasmus Buddy Friends International Calls The program Erasmus+, the European Union programme for Education, Training, Youth and Sport, aims to give over four million people, including students, trainees, teachers and volunteers, the opportunity to benefit from grants to study, train, teach or volunteer abroad. Erasmus+ is part of a socio-economic context where, on the one hand, almost 6 million young Europeans are unemployed, with levels exceeding 50% in some countries. At the same time, there are over 2 million job vacancies and a third of employers report difficulties in recruiting staff with the required qualifications. This demonstrates the existence of significant skills gaps in Europe. Erasmus+ is designed to provide concrete answers to these issues, through opportunities for study, training, work experience or volunteering abroad. The quality and relevance of European education, training and youth care organisations and systems will be increased through support for improved teaching and learning methods, new programmes and the professional development of teaching staff and youth workers, and through increased cooperation between the worlds of education and training and the world of work to address real needs in terms of human and social capital development, in Europe and beyond. Outgoing mobility UKE Student Mobility Choose from partner universities for international experiences and enrich your path. UKE Teacher Mobility Expand your career path with international experiences at partner universities. Mobility for staff TA Enrich your journey with unique experiences at international partner universities. Erasmus+ Tutor The Erasmus+ Representatives are your point of reference for all the information and assistance you need during the program. They will accompany you in every phase, from the initial orientation to filling out the paperwork, ensuring you have a simple and obstacle-free mobility experience abroad. Thanks to a network of partner universities throughout Europe, you will be able to live an international experience, improve your language skills and broaden your cultural and professional horizons. The program Outgoing mobility Erasmus+ Tutor Erasmus+ Projects ECHE Erasmus Experiences Erasmus Buddy Friends International Calls The program Erasmus+, the European Union programme for Education, Training, Youth and Sport, aims to give over four million people, including students, trainees, teachers and volunteers, the opportunity to benefit from grants to study, train, teach or volunteer abroad. Erasmus+ is part of a socio-economic context where, on the one hand, almost 6 million young Europeans are unemployed, with levels exceeding 50% in some countries. At the same time, there are over 2 million job vacancies and a third of employers report difficulties in recruiting staff with the required qualifications. This demonstrates the existence of significant skills gaps in Europe. Erasmus+ is designed to provide concrete answers to these issues, through opportunities for study, training, work experience or volunteering abroad. The quality and relevance of European education, training and youth care organisations and systems will be increased through support for improved teaching and learning methods, new programmes and the professional development of teaching staff and youth workers, and through increased cooperation between the worlds of education and training and the world of work to address real needs in terms of human and social capital development, in Europe and beyond. Outgoing mobility UKE Student Mobility Choose from partner universities for international experiences and enrich your path. UKE Teacher Mobility Expand your career path with international experiences at partner universities. Mobility for staff TA Enrich your journey with unique experiences at international partner universities. Erasmus+ Tutor The Erasmus+ Representatives are your point of reference for all the information and assistance you need during the program. They will accompany you in every phase, from the initial orientation to filling out the paperwork, ensuring you have a simple and obstacle-free mobility experience abroad. Chi siamo Attualmente il CDE costituisce un organismo di informazione europeo le cui finalità sono: promuovere e consolidare l’insegnamento e la ricerca nel campo dell’integrazione europea; rendere accessibile al pubblico, compreso quello non universitario, l’informazione sull’Unione europea e le sue politiche; stabilire contatti con altri CDE e reti di informazione europei al fine di partecipare al dibattito sull’Unione Europea; A tal fine le funzioni del CDE sono: Future students Enrolled students Teachers Work with UKE Student/Faculty Portal gestire le pubblicazioni ufficiali ricevute dalle istituzioni comunitarie; rendere fruibili al pubblico tali pubblicazioni, attraverso la consultazione e la divulgazione; cooperare con gli altri CDE e con le altre reti di informazione; contribuire alle attività di informazione e formazione della Commissione Europea sull’Unione europea. Il CDE dispone, inoltre, di accessi privilegiati alle banche dati comunitarie. Il CDE gestisce tra l’altro la rivista KorEuropa Digital Brochure CDE Vademecum 06-07-2020 Iniziative recenti e in corso CDE Contacts The CDE of the Kore University of Enna is located inside the Central University Library. This will be achieved through the development of professionalizing academic training offerings, jòìnt educational programs, and advanced training and research projects, fostering a process of extra-European integration with a long-term structural, sustainable, and systemic cooperation in the fields of education, research, and innovation at a transborder level. This objective will be realized through the inìtiation of intercultural exchanges and a program of physical virtual mobility for students, Ph.D. candidates, researchers, and educators. Additionally, it will involve initiatives for advanced second­ level training to support innovation and competitiveness by enhancing existing educational systems and experimenting with innovative training methodologies capable of addressing societal challenges in an innovative and multidisciplinary manner. The proposed model of higher education is based on the importance of an economy that combines growth and sustainability through the development of a broad spectrum of knowledge in the fields of science and technology. It also involves the transfer of experimental deep tech and technology-driven training practices into clinical and healthcare engineering practices. The Multidisciplinary Center organizes and delivers initial teacher training courses for lower and upper secondary schools, pursuant to the Prime Ministerial Decree of 4 August 2023. As a university service structure, the Multidisciplinary Centre coordinates and organizes UKE initiatives in the field of initial and in-service training of school staff, also for research purposes, and takes care of and maintains relationships with the world of schools in general. Specialization course support Specialize in school support and gain the skills to support inclusion. PASS is, in fact, the acronym for Placement, Apprenticeship and Services for the employment of Students. Job placement The UP Center designs, plans and implements all those initiatives aimed at strengthening the relationship between academic studies and the world of work, offering constant support to Kore students and graduates. In particular, the UP Center: It deals with services relating to professional internships, pre- and post-degrees, and national and international high-level apprenticeships; It supports Kore students and graduates who intend to start their own businesses, assisting them in the initial phase and thus acting as a business incubator; Conducts studies and research on the employment opportunities of its graduates; Promotes and organizes “meet ups”, meetings with companies interested in recruiting initiatives and job and career orientation workshops; It manages relations with companies and public and private institutions aimed at promoting the intermediation between job supply and demand; It follows its graduates in their path to job placement and university training, verifying, in collaboration with the Alma Laurea consortium, their individual development for up to five years after graduation. Apprenticeship Visit this section to activate the external internship provided for in your study plan. Placement With the Placement activity, the UKE PASS Center intends to offer its students and graduates all those activities aimed at preparing them to face the job market. PASS is, in fact, the acronym for Placement, Apprenticeship and Services for the employment of Students. Job placement The UP Center designs, plans and implements all those initiatives aimed at strengthening the relationship between academic studies and the world of work, offering constant support to Kore students and graduates. In particular, the UP Center: It deals with services relating to professional internships, pre- and post-degrees, and national and international high-level apprenticeships; It supports Kore students and graduates who intend to start their own businesses, assisting them in the initial phase and thus acting as a business incubator; Conducts studies and research on the employment opportunities of its graduates; Promotes and organizes “meet ups”, meetings with companies interested in recruiting initiatives and job and career orientation workshops; It manages relations with companies and public and private institutions aimed at promoting the intermediation between job supply and demand; It follows its graduates in their path to job placement and university training, verifying, in collaboration with the Alma Laurea consortium, their individual development for up to five years after graduation. Apprenticeship Visit this section to activate the external internship provided for in your study plan. Placement With the Placement activity, the UKE PASS Center intends to offer its students and graduates all those activities aimed at preparing them to face the job market. PASS is, in fact, the acronym for Placement, Apprenticeship and Services for the employment of Students. Job placement The UP Center designs, plans and implements all those initiatives aimed at strengthening the relationship between academic studies and the world of work, offering constant support to Kore students and graduates. In particular, the UP Center: It deals with services relating to professional internships, pre- and post-degrees, and national and international high-level apprenticeships; It supports Kore students and graduates who intend to start their own businesses, assisting them in the initial phase and thus acting as a business incubator; Conducts studies and research on the employment opportunities of its graduates; Promotes and organizes “meet ups”, meetings with companies interested in recruiting initiatives and job and career orientation workshops; It manages relations with companies and public and private institutions aimed at promoting the intermediation between job supply and demand; It follows its graduates in their path to job placement and university training, verifying, in collaboration with the Alma Laurea consortium, their individual development for up to five years after graduation. Apprenticeship Visit this section to activate the external internship provided for in your study plan. Placement With the Placement activity, the UKE PASS Center intends to offer its students and graduates all those activities aimed at preparing them to face the job market. PASS is, in fact, the acronym for Placement, Apprenticeship and Services for the employment of Students. Job placement The UP Center designs, plans and implements all those initiatives aimed at strengthening the relationship between academic studies and the world of work, offering constant support to Kore students and graduates. PASS is, in fact, the acronym for Placement, Apprenticeship and Services for the employment of Students. Job placement The UP Center designs, plans and implements all those initiatives aimed at strengthening the relationship between academic studies and the world of work, offering constant support to Kore students and graduates. In particular, the UP Center: It deals with services relating to professional internships, pre- and post-degrees, and national and international high-level apprenticeships; It supports Kore students and graduates who intend to start their own businesses, assisting them in the initial phase and thus acting as a business incubator; Conducts studies and research on the employment opportunities of its graduates; Promotes and organizes “meet ups”, meetings with companies interested in recruiting initiatives and job and career orientation workshops; It manages relations with companies and public and private institutions aimed at promoting the intermediation between job supply and demand; It follows its graduates in their path to job placement and university training, verifying, in collaboration with the Alma Laurea consortium, their individual development for up to five years after graduation. Apprenticeship Visit this section to activate the external internship provided for in your study plan. Placement With the Placement activity, the UKE PASS Center intends to offer its students and graduates all those activities aimed at preparing them to face the job market. PASS is, in fact, the acronym for Placement, Apprenticeship and Services for the employment of Students. Job placement The UP Center designs, plans and implements all those initiatives aimed at strengthening the relationship between academic studies and the world of work, offering constant support to Kore students and graduates. In particular, the UP Center: It deals with services relating to professional internships, pre- and post-degrees, and national and international high-level apprenticeships; It supports Kore students and graduates who intend to start their own businesses, assisting them in the initial phase and thus acting as a business incubator; Conducts studies and research on the employment opportunities of its graduates; Promotes and organizes “meet ups”, meetings with companies interested in recruiting initiatives and job and career orientation workshops; It manages relations with companies and public and private institutions aimed at promoting the intermediation between job supply and demand; It follows its graduates in their path to job placement and university training, verifying, in collaboration with the Alma Laurea consortium, their individual development for up to five years after graduation. Apprenticeship Visit this section to activate the external internship provided for in your study plan. Placement With the Placement activity, the UKE PASS Center intends to offer its students and graduates all those activities aimed at preparing them to face the job market. Grazie a una rete di università partner in tutta Europa, potrai vivere un'esperienza internazionale, migliorare le tue competenze linguistiche e ampliare i tuoi orizzonti culturali e professionali. Il programma Mobilità in uscita Tutor Erasmus+ Progetti Erasmus+ ECHE Esperienze Erasmus Erasmus Buddy Friends Bandi internazionali Accordi e network Il programma Erasmus+, il programma dell’Unione europea per l’Istruzione, la Formazione, la Gioventù e lo Sport, si pone l’obiettivo di dare l’opportunità a oltre quattro milioni di persone, fra cui studentesse e studenti, tirocinanti, insegnanti, volontarie e volontari, di beneficiare di sovvenzioni per attività di studio, formazione, insegnamento o volontariato all’estero. Erasmus+ si inserisce in un contesto socio-economico che vede, da una parte, quasi 6 milioni di giovani europei disoccupati, con livelli che in alcuni paesi superano il 50%. Allo stesso tempo si registrano oltre 2 milioni di posti di lavoro vacanti e un terzo dei datori di lavoro segnala difficoltà ad assumere personale con le qualifiche richieste. Ciò dimostra il sussistere di importanti deficit di competenze in Europa. Erasmus+ è pensato per dare risposte concrete a queste problematiche, attraverso opportunità di studio, formazione, di esperienze lavorative o di volontariato all’estero. La qualità e la pertinenza delle organizzazioni e dei sistemi europei d’istruzione, formazione e assistenza ai giovani saranno incrementate attraverso il sostegno al miglioramento dei metodi di insegnamento e apprendimento, a nuovi programmi e allo sviluppo professionale del personale docente e degli animatori giovanili, e attraverso una maggiore cooperazione tra il mondo dell’istruzione e della formazione e il mondo del lavoro per affrontare le reali necessità in termini di sviluppo del capitale umano e sociale, in Europa e altrove. Mobilità in uscita Mobilità per studenti UKE Scegli tra università partner per esperienze internazionali e arricchisci il tuo percorso. Mobilità per docenti UKE Amplia il tuo percorso con esperienze internazionali presso università partner. Mobilità per staff TA Arricchisci il tuo percorso con esperienze uniche in università partner internazionali. Tutor Erasmus+ I Referenti Erasmus+ sono il tuo punto di riferimento per tutte le informazioni e l’assistenza necessaria durante il programma. Ti accompagneranno in ogni fase, dall’orientamento iniziale alla compilazione delle pratiche, garantendoti un’esperienza di mobilità all’estero semplice e senza ostacoli. Tutor Erasmus+ Progetti Erasmus+ Capacity Building Erasmus+ Higher Education International Credit Mobility – ICM - Ka171 KA220-HED - Cooperation Partnerships Blended Intensive Programs (BIP) Sviluppati da gruppi di Istituti di istruzione superiore con un approccio pedagogico innovativo, i BIP prevedono brevi periodi di attività in presenza combinata con attività di apprendimento e cooperazione online, a cui possono partecipare gruppi congiunti di studenti, personale docente e staff amministrativo provenienti da diversi Paesi per collaborare a specifici compiti in modo collettivo e simultaneo. Grazie a una rete di università partner in tutta Europa, potrai vivere un'esperienza internazionale, migliorare le tue competenze linguistiche e ampliare i tuoi orizzonti culturali e professionali. Il programma Mobilità in uscita Tutor Erasmus+ Progetti Erasmus+ ECHE Esperienze Erasmus Erasmus Buddy Friends Bandi internazionali Accordi e network Il programma Erasmus+, il programma dell’Unione europea per l’Istruzione, la Formazione, la Gioventù e lo Sport, si pone l’obiettivo di dare l’opportunità a oltre quattro milioni di persone, fra cui studentesse e studenti, tirocinanti, insegnanti, volontarie e volontari, di beneficiare di sovvenzioni per attività di studio, formazione, insegnamento o volontariato all’estero. Erasmus+ si inserisce in un contesto socio-economico che vede, da una parte, quasi 6 milioni di giovani europei disoccupati, con livelli che in alcuni paesi superano il 50%. Allo stesso tempo si registrano oltre 2 milioni di posti di lavoro vacanti e un terzo dei datori di lavoro segnala difficoltà ad assumere personale con le qualifiche richieste. Ciò dimostra il sussistere di importanti deficit di competenze in Europa. Erasmus+ è pensato per dare risposte concrete a queste problematiche, attraverso opportunità di studio, formazione, di esperienze lavorative o di volontariato all’estero. La qualità e la pertinenza delle organizzazioni e dei sistemi europei d’istruzione, formazione e assistenza ai giovani saranno incrementate attraverso il sostegno al miglioramento dei metodi di insegnamento e apprendimento, a nuovi programmi e allo sviluppo professionale del personale docente e degli animatori giovanili, e attraverso una maggiore cooperazione tra il mondo dell’istruzione e della formazione e il mondo del lavoro per affrontare le reali necessità in termini di sviluppo del capitale umano e sociale, in Europa e altrove. Mobilità in uscita Mobilità per studenti UKE Scegli tra università partner per esperienze internazionali e arricchisci il tuo percorso. Mobilità per docenti UKE Amplia il tuo percorso con esperienze internazionali presso università partner. Mobilità per staff TA Arricchisci il tuo percorso con esperienze uniche in università partner internazionali. Erasmus+ si inserisce in un contesto socio-economico che vede, da una parte, quasi 6 milioni di giovani europei disoccupati, con livelli che in alcuni paesi superano il 50%. Allo stesso tempo si registrano oltre 2 milioni di posti di lavoro vacanti e un terzo dei datori di lavoro segnala difficoltà ad assumere personale con le qualifiche richieste. Ciò dimostra il sussistere di importanti deficit di competenze in Europa. Grazie a una rete di università partner in tutta Europa, potrai vivere un'esperienza internazionale, migliorare le tue competenze linguistiche e ampliare i tuoi orizzonti culturali e professionali. Il programma Mobilità in uscita Tutor Erasmus+ Progetti Erasmus+ ECHE Esperienze Erasmus Erasmus Buddy Friends Bandi internazionali Accordi e network Il programma Erasmus+, il programma dell’Unione europea per l’Istruzione, la Formazione, la Gioventù e lo Sport, si pone l’obiettivo di dare l’opportunità a oltre quattro milioni di persone, fra cui studentesse e studenti, tirocinanti, insegnanti, volontarie e volontari, di beneficiare di sovvenzioni per attività di studio, formazione, insegnamento o volontariato all’estero. Erasmus+ si inserisce in un contesto socio-economico che vede, da una parte, quasi 6 milioni di giovani europei disoccupati, con livelli che in alcuni paesi superano il 50%. Allo stesso tempo si registrano oltre 2 milioni di posti di lavoro vacanti e un terzo dei datori di lavoro segnala difficoltà ad assumere personale con le qualifiche richieste. Ciò dimostra il sussistere di importanti deficit di competenze in Europa. Erasmus+ è pensato per dare risposte concrete a queste problematiche, attraverso opportunità di studio, formazione, di esperienze lavorative o di volontariato all’estero. La qualità e la pertinenza delle organizzazioni e dei sistemi europei d’istruzione, formazione e assistenza ai giovani saranno incrementate attraverso il sostegno al miglioramento dei metodi di insegnamento e apprendimento, a nuovi programmi e allo sviluppo professionale del personale docente e degli animatori giovanili, e attraverso una maggiore cooperazione tra il mondo dell’istruzione e della formazione e il mondo del lavoro per affrontare le reali necessità in termini di sviluppo del capitale umano e sociale, in Europa e altrove. Mobilità in uscita Mobilità per studenti UKE Scegli tra università partner per esperienze internazionali e arricchisci il tuo percorso. Mobilità per docenti UKE Amplia il tuo percorso con esperienze internazionali presso università partner. Mobilità per staff TA Arricchisci il tuo percorso con esperienze uniche in università partner internazionali. Tutor Erasmus+ I Referenti Erasmus+ sono il tuo punto di riferimento per tutte le informazioni e l’assistenza necessaria durante il programma. Ti accompagneranno in ogni fase, dall’orientamento iniziale alla compilazione delle pratiche, garantendoti un’esperienza di mobilità all’estero semplice e senza ostacoli. Grazie a una rete di università partner in tutta Europa, potrai vivere un'esperienza internazionale, migliorare le tue competenze linguistiche e ampliare i tuoi orizzonti culturali e professionali. Il programma Mobilità in uscita Tutor Erasmus+ Progetti Erasmus+ ECHE Esperienze Erasmus Erasmus Buddy Friends Bandi internazionali Accordi e network Erasmus+ - Università degli Studi di Enna "Kore" Futuri studenti Studenti iscritti Docenti Lavorare con UKE Portale CINECA Agenda WEB Il programma Erasmus+, il programma dell’Unione europea per l’Istruzione, la Formazione, la Gioventù e lo Sport, si pone l’obiettivo di dare l’opportunità a oltre quattro milioni di persone, fra cui studentesse e studenti, tirocinanti, insegnanti, volontarie e volontari, di beneficiare di sovvenzioni per attività di studio, formazione, insegnamento o volontariato all’estero. Erasmus+ si inserisce in un contesto socio-economico che vede, da una parte, quasi 6 milioni di giovani europei disoccupati, con livelli che in alcuni paesi superano il 50%. Allo stesso tempo si registrano oltre 2 milioni di posti di lavoro vacanti e un terzo dei datori di lavoro segnala difficoltà ad assumere personale con le qualifiche richieste. Ciò dimostra il sussistere di importanti deficit di competenze in Europa. Erasmus+ è pensato per dare risposte concrete a queste problematiche, attraverso opportunità di studio, formazione, di esperienze lavorative o di volontariato all’estero. La qualità e la pertinenza delle organizzazioni e dei sistemi europei d’istruzione, formazione e assistenza ai giovani saranno incrementate attraverso il sostegno al miglioramento dei metodi di insegnamento e apprendimento, a nuovi programmi e allo sviluppo professionale del personale docente e degli animatori giovanili, e attraverso una maggiore cooperazione tra il mondo dell’istruzione e della formazione e il mondo del lavoro per affrontare le reali necessità in termini di sviluppo del capitale umano e sociale, in Europa e altrove. Mobilità per staff TA Arricchisci il tuo percorso con esperienze uniche in università partner internazionali. Grazie a una rete di università partner in tutta Europa, potrai vivere un'esperienza internazionale, migliorare le tue competenze linguistiche e ampliare i tuoi orizzonti culturali e professionali. Il programma Mobilità in uscita Tutor Erasmus+ Progetti Erasmus+ ECHE Esperienze Erasmus Erasmus Buddy Friends Bandi internazionali Accordi e network Erasmus+ - Università degli Studi di Enna "Kore" Futuri studenti Studenti iscritti Docenti Lavorare con UKE Portale CINECA Agenda WEB Il programma Erasmus+, il programma dell’Unione europea per l’Istruzione, la Formazione, la Gioventù e lo Sport, si pone l’obiettivo di dare l’opportunità a oltre quattro milioni di persone, fra cui studentesse e studenti, tirocinanti, insegnanti, volontarie e volontari, di beneficiare di sovvenzioni per attività di studio, formazione, insegnamento o volontariato all’estero. Erasmus+ si inserisce in un contesto socio-economico che vede, da una parte, quasi 6 milioni di giovani europei disoccupati, con livelli che in alcuni paesi superano il 50%. Allo stesso tempo si registrano oltre 2 milioni di posti di lavoro vacanti e un terzo dei datori di lavoro segnala difficoltà ad assumere personale con le qualifiche richieste. Ciò dimostra il sussistere di importanti deficit di competenze in Europa. Erasmus+ è pensato per dare risposte concrete a queste problematiche, attraverso opportunità di studio, formazione, di esperienze lavorative o di volontariato all’estero. La qualità e la pertinenza delle organizzazioni e dei sistemi europei d’istruzione, formazione e assistenza ai giovani saranno incrementate attraverso il sostegno al miglioramento dei metodi di insegnamento e apprendimento, a nuovi programmi e allo sviluppo professionale del personale docente e degli animatori giovanili, e attraverso una maggiore cooperazione tra il mondo dell’istruzione e della formazione e il mondo del lavoro per affrontare le reali necessità in termini di sviluppo del capitale umano e sociale, in Europa e altrove. Grazie a una rete di università partner in tutta Europa, potrai vivere un'esperienza internazionale, migliorare le tue competenze linguistiche e ampliare i tuoi orizzonti culturali e professionali. Il programma Mobilità in uscita Tutor Erasmus+ Progetti Erasmus+ ECHE Esperienze Erasmus Erasmus Buddy Friends Bandi internazionali Accordi e network Erasmus+ - Università degli Studi di Enna "Kore" Futuri studenti Studenti iscritti Docenti Lavorare con UKE Portale CINECA Agenda WEB Il programma Erasmus+, il programma dell’Unione europea per l’Istruzione, la Formazione, la Gioventù e lo Sport, si pone l’obiettivo di dare l’opportunità a oltre quattro milioni di persone, fra cui studentesse e studenti, tirocinanti, insegnanti, volontarie e volontari, di beneficiare di sovvenzioni per attività di studio, formazione, insegnamento o volontariato all’estero. Erasmus+ si inserisce in un contesto socio-economico che vede, da una parte, quasi 6 milioni di giovani europei disoccupati, con livelli che in alcuni paesi superano il 50%. Allo stesso tempo si registrano oltre 2 milioni di posti di lavoro vacanti e un terzo dei datori di lavoro segnala difficoltà ad assumere personale con le qualifiche richieste. Ciò dimostra il sussistere di importanti deficit di competenze in Europa. Erasmus+ è pensato per dare risposte concrete a queste problematiche, attraverso opportunità di studio, formazione, di esperienze lavorative o di volontariato all’estero. La qualità e la pertinenza delle organizzazioni e dei sistemi europei d’istruzione, formazione e assistenza ai giovani saranno incrementate attraverso il sostegno al miglioramento dei metodi di insegnamento e apprendimento, a nuovi programmi e allo sviluppo professionale del personale docente e degli animatori giovanili, e attraverso una maggiore cooperazione tra il mondo dell’istruzione e della formazione e il mondo del lavoro per affrontare le reali necessità in termini di sviluppo del capitale umano e sociale, in Europa e altrove. Mobilità in uscita Mobilità per studenti UKE Scegli tra università partner per esperienze internazionali e arricchisci il tuo percorso. Mobilità per docenti UKE Amplia il tuo percorso con esperienze internazionali presso università partner. Mobilità per staff TA Arricchisci il tuo percorso con esperienze uniche in università partner internazionali. Tutor Erasmus+ I Referenti Erasmus+ sono il tuo punto di riferimento per tutte le informazioni e l’assistenza necessaria durante il programma. Ti accompagneranno in ogni fase, dall’orientamento iniziale alla compilazione delle pratiche, garantendoti un’esperienza di mobilità all’estero semplice e senza ostacoli. Grazie a una rete di università partner in tutta Europa, potrai vivere un'esperienza internazionale, migliorare le tue competenze linguistiche e ampliare i tuoi orizzonti culturali e professionali. Il programma Mobilità in uscita Tutor Erasmus+ Progetti Erasmus+ ECHE Esperienze Erasmus Erasmus Buddy Friends Bandi internazionali Accordi e network Erasmus+ - Università degli Studi di Enna "Kore" Futuri studenti Studenti iscritti Docenti Lavorare con UKE Portale CINECA Agenda WEB Il programma Erasmus+, il programma dell’Unione europea per l’Istruzione, la Formazione, la Gioventù e lo Sport, si pone l’obiettivo di dare l’opportunità a oltre quattro milioni di persone, fra cui studentesse e studenti, tirocinanti, insegnanti, volontarie e volontari, di beneficiare di sovvenzioni per attività di studio, formazione, insegnamento o volontariato all’estero. Erasmus+ si inserisce in un contesto socio-economico che vede, da una parte, quasi 6 milioni di giovani europei disoccupati, con livelli che in alcuni paesi superano il 50%. Allo stesso tempo si registrano oltre 2 milioni di posti di lavoro vacanti e un terzo dei datori di lavoro segnala difficoltà ad assumere personale con le qualifiche richieste. Ciò dimostra il sussistere di importanti deficit di competenze in Europa. Erasmus+ è pensato per dare risposte concrete a queste problematiche, attraverso opportunità di studio, formazione, di esperienze lavorative o di volontariato all’estero. La qualità e la pertinenza delle organizzazioni e dei sistemi europei d’istruzione, formazione e assistenza ai giovani saranno incrementate attraverso il sostegno al miglioramento dei metodi di insegnamento e apprendimento, a nuovi programmi e allo sviluppo professionale del personale docente e degli animatori giovanili, e attraverso una maggiore cooperazione tra il mondo dell’istruzione e della formazione e il mondo del lavoro per affrontare le reali necessità in termini di sviluppo del capitale umano e sociale, in Europa e altrove. Mobilità in uscita Mobilità per studenti UKE Scegli tra università partner per esperienze internazionali e arricchisci il tuo percorso. Mobilità per docenti UKE Amplia il tuo percorso con esperienze internazionali presso università partner. Mobilità per staff TA Arricchisci il tuo percorso con esperienze uniche in università partner internazionali. Tutor Erasmus+ I Referenti Erasmus+ sono il tuo punto di riferimento per tutte le informazioni e l’assistenza necessaria durante il programma. Ti accompagneranno in ogni fase, dall’orientamento iniziale alla compilazione delle pratiche, garantendoti un’esperienza di mobilità all’estero semplice e senza ostacoli. Grazie a una rete di università partner in tutta Europa, potrai vivere un'esperienza internazionale, migliorare le tue competenze linguistiche e ampliare i tuoi orizzonti culturali e professionali. Il programma Mobilità in uscita Tutor Erasmus+ Progetti Erasmus+ ECHE Esperienze Erasmus Erasmus Buddy Friends Bandi internazionali Accordi e network Erasmus+ - Università degli Studi di Enna "Kore" Futuri studenti Studenti iscritti Docenti Lavorare con UKE Portale CINECA Agenda WEB Il programma Erasmus+, il programma dell’Unione europea per l’Istruzione, la Formazione, la Gioventù e lo Sport, si pone l’obiettivo di dare l’opportunità a oltre quattro milioni di persone, fra cui studentesse e studenti, tirocinanti, insegnanti, volontarie e volontari, di beneficiare di sovvenzioni per attività di studio, formazione, insegnamento o volontariato all’estero. Erasmus+ si inserisce in un contesto socio-economico che vede, da una parte, quasi 6 milioni di giovani europei disoccupati, con livelli che in alcuni paesi superano il 50%. Allo stesso tempo si registrano oltre 2 milioni di posti di lavoro vacanti e un terzo dei datori di lavoro segnala difficoltà ad assumere personale con le qualifiche richieste. Ciò dimostra il sussistere di importanti deficit di competenze in Europa. Erasmus+ è pensato per dare risposte concrete a queste problematiche, attraverso opportunità di studio, formazione, di esperienze lavorative o di volontariato all’estero. La qualità e la pertinenza delle organizzazioni e dei sistemi europei d’istruzione, formazione e assistenza ai giovani saranno incrementate attraverso il sostegno al miglioramento dei metodi di insegnamento e apprendimento, a nuovi programmi e allo sviluppo professionale del personale docente e degli animatori giovanili, e attraverso una maggiore cooperazione tra il mondo dell’istruzione e della formazione e il mondo del lavoro per affrontare le reali necessità in termini di sviluppo del capitale umano e sociale, in Europa e altrove. Mobilità per staff TA Arricchisci il tuo percorso con esperienze uniche in università partner internazionali. Grazie a una rete di università partner in tutta Europa, potrai vivere un'esperienza internazionale, migliorare le tue competenze linguistiche e ampliare i tuoi orizzonti culturali e professionali. Il programma Mobilità in uscita Tutor Erasmus+ Progetti Erasmus+ ECHE Esperienze Erasmus Erasmus Buddy Friends Bandi internazionali Accordi e network Erasmus+ - Università degli Studi di Enna "Kore" Futuri studenti Studenti iscritti Docenti Lavorare con UKE Portale CINECA Agenda WEB Il programma Erasmus+, il programma dell’Unione europea per l’Istruzione, la Formazione, la Gioventù e lo Sport, si pone l’obiettivo di dare l’opportunità a oltre quattro milioni di persone, fra cui studentesse e studenti, tirocinanti, insegnanti, volontarie e volontari, di beneficiare di sovvenzioni per attività di studio, formazione, insegnamento o volontariato all’estero. Erasmus+ si inserisce in un contesto socio-economico che vede, da una parte, quasi 6 milioni di giovani europei disoccupati, con livelli che in alcuni paesi superano il 50%. Allo stesso tempo si registrano oltre 2 milioni di posti di lavoro vacanti e un terzo dei datori di lavoro segnala difficoltà ad assumere personale con le qualifiche richieste. Ciò dimostra il sussistere di importanti deficit di competenze in Europa. Erasmus+ è pensato per dare risposte concrete a queste problematiche, attraverso opportunità di studio, formazione, di esperienze lavorative o di volontariato all’estero. La qualità e la pertinenza delle organizzazioni e dei sistemi europei d’istruzione, formazione e assistenza ai giovani saranno incrementate attraverso il sostegno al miglioramento dei metodi di insegnamento e apprendimento, a nuovi programmi e allo sviluppo professionale del personale docente e degli animatori giovanili, e attraverso una maggiore cooperazione tra il mondo dell’istruzione e della formazione e il mondo del lavoro per affrontare le reali necessità in termini di sviluppo del capitale umano e sociale, in Europa e altrove. Mobilità in uscita Mobilità per studenti UKE Scegli tra università partner per esperienze internazionali e arricchisci il tuo percorso. Mobilità per docenti UKE Amplia il tuo percorso con esperienze internazionali presso università partner. Mobilità per staff TA Arricchisci il tuo percorso con esperienze uniche in università partner internazionali. Tutor Erasmus+ I Referenti Erasmus+ sono il tuo punto di riferimento per tutte le informazioni e l’assistenza necessaria durante il programma. Ti accompagneranno in ogni fase, dall’orientamento iniziale alla compilazione delle pratiche, garantendoti un’esperienza di mobilità all’estero semplice e senza ostacoli. Our goal is to guarantee equal opportunities, promoting a welcoming community that values every student. Disability and DSA Service (KODIS) The Kore University of Enna, through KODIS – University Commission for Disability (University Disability/DSA Service) organizes and promotes services aimed at University students who find themselves in difficulty due to physical and/or sensory disabilities, or students with learning difficulties, in compliance with the CNUDD 2002-2014 guidelines. The services aim to guarantee students equality in study opportunities and class attendance. KODIS therefore coordinates the assignment of services and all initiatives aimed at improving the quality of life of students enrolled at Kore University who present temporary or permanent disadvantages. The purpose of KODIS is to promote and establish collaborative relationships with other University services and with Territorial Institutions, in order to coordinate interventions, raise awareness and contribute to the development of a new culture of inclusion. Future students Enrolled students Teachers Work with UKE Student/Faculty Portal How to use KODIS service? To access the Service, you must register by sending the following to the University protocol ( protocol@unikore.it ): a valid medical certificate attesting to the disability and/or DSA condition issued by a public body of the National Health Service (or accredited private structures); the service access form (downloadable from the section forms on this page web) filled out in all its parts, indicating the services you intend to request; your identity document. NB For students with DSA: As required by Law 170/2010, clinical diagnoses of DSA must be issued by National Health Service facilities or, depending on the region, by accredited specialists or facilities, or by private specialists or centers whose diagnosis must be validated by the relevant ASL. The diagnosis must be updated every 3 years (or when moving from one school level to another) if it is carried out by a minor student, while the update is no longer mandatory if the student has already reached the age of 18. It will therefore be valid for the entire duration of the university course. NB for all students: To benefit from the KODIS service assistance, it is necessary to renew the registration at the beginning of each academic year by repeating the procedure listed above. Students with Disabilities Disability services promote the inclusion of students with disabilities in university life. In particular, they aim to remove obstacles of various kinds and to create conditions of equal opportunities for study and treatment. Peer-to-peer tutoring Exam Support Mediation interventions Tax reduction Reference legislation Students with DSA The University provides students with DSA with services that ensure their inclusion within the university community and that take into account their specific characteristics and needs. Our goal is to guarantee equal opportunities, promoting a welcoming community that values every student. Disability and DSA Service (KODIS) The Kore University of Enna, through KODIS – University Commission for Disability (University Disability/DSA Service) organizes and promotes services aimed at University students who find themselves in difficulty due to physical and/or sensory disabilities, or students with learning difficulties, in compliance with the CNUDD 2002-2014 guidelines. The services aim to guarantee students equality in study opportunities and class attendance. KODIS therefore coordinates the assignment of services and all initiatives aimed at improving the quality of life of students enrolled at Kore University who present temporary or permanent disadvantages. The purpose of KODIS is to promote and establish collaborative relationships with other University services and with Territorial Institutions, in order to coordinate interventions, raise awareness and contribute to the development of a new culture of inclusion. Future students Enrolled students Teachers Work with UKE Student/Faculty Portal How to use KODIS service? To access the Service, you must register by sending the following to the University protocol ( protocol@unikore.it ): a valid medical certificate attesting to the disability and/or DSA condition issued by a public body of the National Health Service (or accredited private structures); the service access form (downloadable from the section forms on this page web) filled out in all its parts, indicating the services you intend to request; your identity document. NB For students with DSA: As required by Law 170/2010, clinical diagnoses of DSA must be issued by National Health Service facilities or, depending on the region, by accredited specialists or facilities, or by private specialists or centers whose diagnosis must be validated by the relevant ASL. The diagnosis must be updated every 3 years (or when moving from one school level to another) if it is carried out by a minor student, while the update is no longer mandatory if the student has already reached the age of 18. It will therefore be valid for the entire duration of the university course. NB for all students: To benefit from the KODIS service assistance, it is necessary to renew the registration at the beginning of each academic year by repeating the procedure listed above. Students with Disabilities Disability services promote the inclusion of students with disabilities in university life. In particular, they aim to remove obstacles of various kinds and to create conditions of equal opportunities for study and treatment. Peer-to-peer tutoring Exam Support Mediation interventions Tax reduction Reference legislation Students with DSA The University provides students with DSA with services that ensure their inclusion within the university community and that take into account their specific characteristics and needs. Our goal is to guarantee equal opportunities, promoting a welcoming community that values every student. Disability and DSA Service (KODIS) The Kore University of Enna, through KODIS – University Commission for Disability (University Disability/DSA Service) organizes and promotes services aimed at University students who find themselves in difficulty due to physical and/or sensory disabilities, or students with learning difficulties, in compliance with the CNUDD 2002-2014 guidelines. The services aim to guarantee students equality in study opportunities and class attendance. KODIS therefore coordinates the assignment of services and all initiatives aimed at improving the quality of life of students enrolled at Kore University who present temporary or permanent disadvantages. The purpose of KODIS is to promote and establish collaborative relationships with other University services and with Territorial Institutions, in order to coordinate interventions, raise awareness and contribute to the development of a new culture of inclusion. Future students Enrolled students Teachers Work with UKE Student/Faculty Portal How to use KODIS service? To access the Service, you must register by sending the following to the University protocol ( protocol@unikore.it ): a valid medical certificate attesting to the disability and/or DSA condition issued by a public body of the National Health Service (or accredited private structures); the service access form (downloadable from the section forms on this page web) filled out in all its parts, indicating the services you intend to request; your identity document. NB For students with DSA: As required by Law 170/2010, clinical diagnoses of DSA must be issued by National Health Service facilities or, depending on the region, by accredited specialists or facilities, or by private specialists or centers whose diagnosis must be validated by the relevant ASL. The diagnosis must be updated every 3 years (or when moving from one school level to another) if it is carried out by a minor student, while the update is no longer mandatory if the student has already reached the age of 18. It will therefore be valid for the entire duration of the university course. NB for all students: To benefit from the KODIS service assistance, it is necessary to renew the registration at the beginning of each academic year by repeating the procedure listed above. Students with Disabilities Disability services promote the inclusion of students with disabilities in university life. In particular, they aim to remove obstacles of various kinds and to create conditions of equal opportunities for study and treatment. Peer-to-peer tutoring Exam Support Mediation interventions Tax reduction Reference legislation Students with DSA The University provides students with DSA with services that ensure their inclusion within the university community and that take into account their specific characteristics and needs. CLIK is part of AICLU, the Italian Association of University Language Centers. The center At the Kore Interfaculty Language Centre, students can learn, in addition to the most widespread European languages and cultures, namely English, French and Spanish, also extra-European languages and cultures such as Arabic and Chinese. Our students can attend special refresher courses, participate in seminars and events held by Visiting Professor from foreign universities, and use the laboratory spaces for independent language learning with the use of multimedia materials. CLIK is also a scientific research center in the field of foreign language teaching. Future students Enrolled students Teachers Work with UKE Student/Faculty Portal Coordinator Collaborators and linguistic experts Who is CLIK dedicated to? Language proficiency Language proficiency courses for all three-year and master's degree courses at our University. Language certifications The Language Centre has agreements with the main language certification bodies and is a training and exam centre for obtaining the following certifications. But there is much more: study rooms, workstations with computer, 600 bag lockers, courses on how to carry out bibliographic research or compile a bibliography, interlibrary loan and Document Delivery. All these services are free for UNIKORE students. The library Future students Enrolled students Teachers Work with UKE Student/Faculty Portal The Library is the visible heart of the University Library System, the building that dominates the University Square, which also overlooks the Rectorate. In fact, in addition to the large library complex that has become a representative icon of the entire Kore University, the University Library System is divided into a series of services that go beyond the traditional library resources and integrates ancient models, current models and above all future models. The Library is the meeting point for all UKE students, its professors and researchers, who can take advantage of particularly comfortable environments suitable for individual study or, in special rooms, also for groups, always with the assistance of the specialized staff who work there. An advanced computer system, which presides over the management of each individual volume of the library's holdings and the reading stations themselves, allows you to access the Library in complete autonomy. With the same complete autonomy, if you wish, you can take books for loan directly using the appropriate self-service desks, obtaining the appropriate receipts and the possibility of crossing the anti-shoplifting exit gates without problems. The supply of books, journals and digital resources is constantly updated. Each UKE teacher can report a need for new acquisitions directly via email to the University Library System, which usually takes care of it in a few days. All textbooks included in the transparency sheets are present in the Library. Service Charter Access to discovery Search Advanced Search Electronic resources Open Access Electronic Resources Databases by Department Electronic resources The UKE Library System offers users the possibility of consulting organized collections of information on digital media (subscribed by the University) of various types: bibliographic, factual, full-text databases, reference works, repertoires; collections of laws, maxims and sentences; entire collections of periodicals, with a prevalent scientific content; collections of full-text digital books (e-books), open access resources. Several digital resources, identified by professors for their scientific validity and usefulness for study and research, can be consulted free of charge in web. In any case, most digital resources can be consulted via Internet from any workstation connected to the University network. Institutional users, students, teachers and staff, can consult the electronic resources for which the University has stipulated specific subscriptions also from external networks, using the EzProxy service. Some digital resources can be consulted only at the Library, in relation to any contractual access limitations (limited maximum number of simultaneous users, password requirement, subscriptions with limited use licenses). But there is much more: study rooms, workstations with computer, 600 bag lockers, courses on how to carry out bibliographic research or compile a bibliography, interlibrary loan and Document Delivery. All these services are free for UNIKORE students. The library Future students Enrolled students Teachers Work with UKE Student/Faculty Portal The Library is the visible heart of the University Library System, the building that dominates the University Square, which also overlooks the Rectorate. In fact, in addition to the large library complex that has become a representative icon of the entire Kore University, the University Library System is divided into a series of services that go beyond the traditional library resources and integrates ancient models, current models and above all future models. The Library is the meeting point for all UKE students, its professors and researchers, who can take advantage of particularly comfortable environments suitable for individual study or, in special rooms, also for groups, always with the assistance of the specialized staff who work there. An advanced computer system, which presides over the management of each individual volume of the library's holdings and the reading stations themselves, allows you to access the Library in complete autonomy. With the same complete autonomy, if you wish, you can take books for loan directly using the appropriate self-service desks, obtaining the appropriate receipts and the possibility of crossing the anti-shoplifting exit gates without problems. The supply of books, journals and digital resources is constantly updated. Each UKE teacher can report a need for new acquisitions directly via email to the University Library System, which usually takes care of it in a few days. All textbooks included in the transparency sheets are present in the Library. Service Charter Access to discovery Search Advanced Search Electronic resources Open Access Electronic Resources Databases by Department Electronic resources The UKE Library System offers users the possibility of consulting organized collections of information on digital media (subscribed by the University) of various types: bibliographic, factual, full-text databases, reference works, repertoires; collections of laws, maxims and sentences; entire collections of periodicals, with a prevalent scientific content; collections of full-text digital books (e-books), open access resources. Several digital resources, identified by professors for their scientific validity and usefulness for study and research, can be consulted free of charge in web. In any case, most digital resources can be consulted via Internet from any workstation connected to the University network. Institutional users, students, teachers and staff, can consult the electronic resources for which the University has stipulated specific subscriptions also from external networks, using the EzProxy service. Some digital resources can be consulted only at the Library, in relation to any contractual access limitations (limited maximum number of simultaneous users, password requirement, subscriptions with limited use licenses). How to donate books Library Funds New accessions Guided tours Fill out the form to book your guided tour of the UKE library.
